title: 28% of job postings on company career sites have been open over 90 days
summary: A report from unlisted.careers finds that 28% of job postings on company career sites have remained open for over 90 days, suggesting widespread 'ghost jobs' that companies advertise without intent to hire. The Hacker News discussion with 334 comments debates causes, including hiring freezes, compliance requirements, and talent pipelining.
